import * as std from "@pulumi/std";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

        input: "pwd",
    }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
    instanceId: "ins-881b1c8w",
    commandName: "terraform-test",
    description: "shell test",
    commandType: "SHELL",
    workingDirectory: "/root",
    timeout: 100,
    saveCommand: false,
    enableParameter: false,
    username: "root",
    outputCosBucketUrl: "https://BucketName-123454321.cos.ap-beijing.myqcloud.com",
    outputCosKeyPrefix: "log",
});

)

func main() {

		invokeBase64encode, err := std.Base64encode(ctx, &std.Base64encodeArgs{
			Input: "pwd",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = tat.NewInvocationCommandAttachment(ctx, "invocation_command_attachment", &tat.InvocationCommandAttachmentArgs{
			Content:            pulumi.String(invokeBase64encode.Result),
			InstanceId:         pulumi.String("ins-881b1c8w"),
			CommandName:        pulumi.String("terraform-test"),
			Description:        pulumi.String("shell test"),

			OutputCosBucketUrl: pulumi.String("https://BucketName-123454321.cos.ap-beijing.myqcloud.com"),
			OutputCosKeyPrefix: pulumi.String("log"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_commandid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">command<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_commandtype_yaml">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_content_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_content_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">content</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

</span>

For example, {varA: 222}.key is the name of the custom parameter and value is the default value. Both key and value are strings.If Parameters is not provided, the default values specified here are used.Up to 20 custom parameters are supported.The name of the custom parameter cannot exceed 64 characters and can contain [a-z], [A-Z], [0-9] and [-_].</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>ID of instances about to execute commands. Supported instance types:  CVM  LIGHTHOUSE.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The COS bucket URL for uploading logs; The URL must start with https, such as https://BucketName-123454321.cos.ap-beijing.myqcloud.com.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The COS bucket directory where the logs are saved; Check below for the rules of the directory name: 1 It must be a combination of number, letters, and visible characters, Up to 60 characters are allowed; 2 Use a slash (/) to create a subdirectory; 3 can not be used as the folder name; It cannot start with a slash (/), and cannot contain consecutive slashes.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_parameters_yaml">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Custom parameters of Command. The field type is JSON encoded string. For example, {varA: 222}.key is the name of the custom parameter and value is the default value. Both key and value are strings.If no parameter value is provided, the DefaultParameters is used.Up to 20 custom parameters are supported.The name of the custom parameter cannot exceed 64 characters and can contain [a-z], [A-Z], [0-9] and [-_].</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Command timeout period. Default value: 60 seconds. Value range: [1, 86400].</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_username_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_username_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">username</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The username used to execute the command on the CVM or Lighthouse instance.The principle of least privilege is the best practice for permission management. We recommend you execute TAT commands as a general user. By default, the user root is used to execute commands on Linux and the user System is used on Windows.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

</span>

        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
